The `blowhorn org` commands. Each one's `--help` prints the same text.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`org members`](#blowhorn-org-members) | List the members of your organization on Blowhorn. |

## blowhorn org members

List the members of your organization on Blowhorn. Each one's user id, name and email, read once from the organization's member list. These are the people a profile can represent: the id is the userId `profile create` and `profile update` take.

```text
blowhorn org members [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit machine-readable JSON output |
| `--platform` | string |  | Accepted and ignored by `blowhorn org`: this command never acts on a platform, so `--platform` has no effect here -- including a value inherited from `BLOWHORN_PLATFORM` or defaults.platform in .blowhorn.yaml |
| `--pace` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn org members` because `--pace` is a global flag, but this command does no paced work -- it sleeps between nothing -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs and appears only in the Pace column of the -v summary. Resolved as CLI flag, then `BLOWHORN_PACE`, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |
| `--risk-profile` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn org members` because `--risk-profile` is a global flag, but this command does no gated work -- no Risk Profile hold, cap or pace applies to it -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs. A value after the command word wins over one before it; an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn org members
blowhorn org members --json
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.
